watch.summary: The streamer reacts with hype and utter disbelief as a pro Valorant player pulls off an insane play.

beats.what: Streamer watches a tense Valorant match with caster commentary.
The pro player aggressively glides through smoke into site.
The pro player gets the kill mid-glide.
Streamer yells in disbelief with his hands up.

watch.author: pro_player_in_footage
watch.why: This clip relies on esports hype and impressive skill rather than pure comedy. The creator's outburst of shock highlights a wild play that primarily appeals to Valorant fans.
